items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] His main instrument was the carnet or trumpet? Trumpet. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Carnet in those days. Yes. In those days.

ctx.x: His main instrument was the carnet or trumpet? Trumpet.
Carnet in those days. Yes. In those days.
Do you mind telling when you were born? Some ladies don't like to tell their age.
